stable.notes: Switching characters now actually switches. Installing a sprite pack or picking a single sprite used to layer on top of whatever was already installed, so any pose the new character did not define stayed owned by the old one. Choosing a legacy pet while an advanced Jedi pack was installed could not change anything on screen. A pack is now built in a scratch folder and swapped in whole, so a pack that fails partway leaves your current character untouched, and an old combat strip can no longer keep fighting under new artwork. Legacy packs draw every state again: error and attention used to fall back only to each other, so a pack carrying neither drew nothing for both. Idle sessions can now be dropped from the pet list. After ten minutes without activity a row shows an x that removes it from the list only. The session keeps running, nothing is deleted, and the row returns on its own the moment it does something. Four parked sessions no longer pin the pet in the five-droid swarm while the one session actually working goes unseen. Double-clicking the character opens the active-session list, so the chevron is no longer the only way in. A single click still opens the focused session and still never expands the list. Pairs with server 6.41.0.

notice.title: One last Accessibility toggle
notice.body: This update changes how COS Control is signed so macOS keeps your Accessibility permission across future updates. macOS drops the old grant one final time: open System Settings, Privacy & Security, Accessibility, toggle COS Control off and on, then reopen COS Control. You will not need to do this again.
